verdict.rationale: Google Workspace provides identity-management building blocks — Directory/Reports/Cloud Identity APIs, Apps Script for 'low-code' automation of admin console tasks, and third-party provisioning sync (e.g., Office 365) — but there is no dedicated no-code workflow builder that triggers app-by-app choreography on hire/role-change/departure events as a packaged feature. Missing for 10: a native no-code trigger-based workflow engine, explicit lifecycle event triggers (hire/role change/departure), and evidence of automated cross-app deprovisioning orchestration beyond scripting/API access.
